purpose: Describe an intended action blocked by circumstances.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
V volitional + にも + same / related V potential negative
Without my key, I cannot go home even though I want to.
I do not know the name, so I cannot search even if I want to.
It hurts so much that I cannot stand up even though I try.
formation: V volitional + にも + same / related V potential negative
restrictions: A practical obstacle prevents even attempting or completing the desired action.
mistake: The second clause must explain inability, not simply unwillingness.
